email.body: With your Fall '26 focus on agentic commerce and new tools for building apps, managing access across complex environments becomes critical. Acme Access provides a single view to right-size permissions for AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, ensuring that as you scale your ecosystem, access remains secure and expires automatically.
email.subject: Securing Shopify's agentic commerce expansion

linkedin.body: I noticed Shopify's recent infrastructure stack includes Cloudflare. As you scale, managing identity across multi-cloud environments can get complex. Acme Access helps security teams right-size access automatically.

call.body: I'm calling because Shopify is expanding its agentic commerce capabilities. As you build more tools for developers and agents, Acme Access helps ensure that access across your cloud environments is right-sized and automatically expires.

objections.objection: We already have robust identity management in place.
objections.response: Acme Access specializes in providing a single view across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud to prevent over-privileged roles.

objections.objection: We don't have the bandwidth to implement new security tools.
objections.response: Our platform is designed to automate access reviews and right-size permissions, reducing the manual workload for your engineers.

objections.objection: We prefer to manage access through our existing cloud providers.
objections.response: Acme Access provides a unified view across all your clouds, preventing silos and ensuring no standing admin rights are left active.
